tools.name: run_cleanup_merged_branches
tools.description: Runs git fetch with prune in a local repository, then deletes local branches that are already merged into the base branch. Returns the names of the branches that were removed.

params.name: repo_path
params.description: Path to the local git repository

params.name: protected
params.description: Branch names that must never be deleted

tools.code:
import subprocess
import contextlib
import os
from langchain_core.tools import tool


@contextlib.contextmanager
def _working_dir(path):
    previous = os.getcwd()
    os.chdir(path)
    try:
        yield
    finally:
        os.chdir(previous)


def _git(*args):
    result = subprocess.run(
        ["git", *args],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=120,
    )
    if result.returncode != 0:
        raise RuntimeError(result.stderr.strip())
    return result.stdout


@tool
def run_cleanup_merged_branches(repo_path: str, base_branch: str = "main", protected: list = None) -> str:
    keep = set(protected or [])
    keep.update({base_branch, "main", "master", "develop"})
    removed = []
    skipped = []
    with _working_dir(repo_path):
        _git("fetch", "--prune")
        current = _git("rev-parse", "--abbrev-ref", "HEAD").strip()
        keep.add(current)
        output = _git("branch", "--merged", base_branch, "--format=%(refname:short)")
        for line in output.splitlines():
            name = line.strip()
            if not name:
                continue
            if name in keep:
                skipped.append(name)
                continue
            try:
                _git("branch", "-d", name)
                removed.append(name)
            except RuntimeError as exc:
                skipped.append(f"{name} ({exc})")
    if not removed:
        return "No merged branches were deleted."
    summary = "Deleted branches: " + ", ".join(removed)
    if skipped:
        summary += "\nSkipped: " + ", ".join(skipped)
    return summary

tools.name: delete_release_tag
tools.description: Deletes a tag from the local repository and removes it from the database of tracked releases.

params.name: db_path
params.description: Path to the sqlite releases database

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from contextlib import closing
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("repo-releases")


@mcp.tool()
def delete_release_tag(db_path: str, tag: str) -> str:
    with closing(sqlite3.connect(db_path)) as conn:
        with conn:
            cur = conn.execute("DELETE FROM releases WHERE tag = ?", (tag,))
            conn.execute("DELETE FROM release_assets WHERE tag = ?", (tag,))
    return f"Removed {cur.rowcount} release record(s) for tag {tag}"

tools.name: move_repo_files
tools.description: Moves files matching a glob pattern from one directory of a repository to another directory within it. Returns the list of new file locations.

params.name: pattern
params.description: Glob pattern of files to move, relative to the source directory

params.name: source_dir
params.description: Source directory relative to the repository

params.name: dest_dir
params.description: Destination directory relative to the repository

tools.code:
import shutil
from pathlib import Path
from langchain_core.tools import tool


def _safe_join(root: Path, relative: str) -> Path:
    candidate = (root / relative).resolve()
    if root.resolve() not in candidate.parents and candidate != root.resolve():
        raise ValueError(f"{relative} escapes the repository")
    return candidate


@tool
def move_repo_files(repo_path: str, pattern: str, source_dir: str, dest_dir: str) -> list:
    root = Path(repo_path)
    source = _safe_join(root, source_dir)
    dest = _safe_join(root, dest_dir)
    dest.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    moved = []
    for item in sorted(source.glob(pattern)):
        if not item.is_file():
            continue
        target = dest / item.name
        if target.exists():
            continue
        shutil.move(str(item), str(target))
        moved.append(str(target.relative_to(root.resolve())))
    return moved
